_comment_corba_variants: CORBA_REMOVAL has two mutually exclusive recipes. This branch (work/jump-811) maps it to jade-recipe-8-11-corba-removal (mode agent), which deletes the generated FIPA IDL stubs and the IIOP MTP. The fallback path, used by the jade-8-to-11 run on master, is jade-recipe-8-11-corba-retrofit (mode script, .claude/skills/java-migration-skill-registry/8-to-11/jade-recipe-8-11-corba-retrofit/scripts/apply.py), which adds GlassFish CORBA jars to the classpath and changes no source. That recipe is left untouched on disk. To switch back, replace the CORBA_REMOVAL entry with {skill, script, description} pointing at it and drop the mode key. Never run both against the same workspace.

TLS_ANON_CIPHER_DISABLED.description: Resolve hard-coded anonymous TLS cipher suites (DH_anon/ECDH_anon) disabled by the JDK 11 default jdk.tls.disabledAlgorithms

CLDR_LOCALE_DATA_DEFAULT.description: Make date/time formatting independent of the default locale data provider, which switched from JRE/COMPAT to CLDR in JDK 9
